assessed_degradation.note: Assessed degradation counts only capacity a source explicitly quantified. It is deliberately distinct from exposure, which counts capacity at disrupted sites regardless of measured loss.

recovery_stats.note: Median rather than mean, since a few long repairs would distort it. Every figure carries its sample size. 'modelled' recovery means no source-reported timing exists and the generic per-sector assumption was used.

coverage_detail.note: Counts of enumerated events only. A low count may mean genuinely low disruption OR thin open-source reporting for that bucket; this dataset cannot always distinguish the two, and does not pretend to.

estimate_days.basis: Industry sources compiled in the English Wikipedia strike table expected the refinery to remain offline at least 6 months after the June 2026 strikes
Industry source cited by Reuters said repairs to the damaged CDU-10 (~38% of plant capacity) would take at least half a year
